proof_summary: The proposed period is valid by a binomial expansion: when \(p^2\mid n\), writing \(n=pm\) with \(p\mid m\) makes every term of \((k+m)^p-k^p\) divisible by \(n\), while translation by \(n\) is immediate otherwise. For minimality, translation modulo each prime \(q\mid n\) first forces \(q\mid T\), and the cases \(k=0,1\) together with a binomial valuation argument give \(v_q(n)\le v_q(p)+v_q(T)\), implying that the proposed period divides every positive period.
